baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three occurrences of م ن ن reverse agent and recipient across يمنون عليك, لا تمنوا علي, and الله يمن عليكم, while submission and guidance name different acts.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human mann is a spoken reminder that places the recipient under a claimed debt; divine mann is the deed of gently enabling movement toward faith. The repeated root therefore stages rival accounts of who acted upon whom and whether submission is a gift, a handover, or evidence of having received one.

activation_trace.role: A weighty favor or its reminder distinguishes human verbal burdening from divine enacted benefaction and drives the agent reversal.
Handing something over supplies the concrete act the claimants try to convert into a debt owed by the Messenger.
Articulated speech marks the human mann as a verbal claim and قل as corrective counter-speech.
Gentle indication and enabling toward a road supplies God's actual deed in place of the claimants' verbal accounting.
Heart-settling confirmation is the destination produced by guidance, not a commodity the speakers deliver.

changed_reading.before: The verse rebukes people for boasting that they converted.
changed_reading.after: The verse contests causal ownership and debt: their speech turns handed-over submission into credit against the Messenger, while God's enacted guidance reveals them as recipients before they can pose as benefactors.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus moves from أسلموا and إسلامكم to هداكم للإيمان, with the directional construction للإيمان and the condition إن كنتم صادقين.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ladder or means image in س ل م and the road-direction images in ه د ي make submission a traversable approach rather than a self-certifying endpoint. Faith is the inwardly settled destination, and truthfulness asks whether that movement has become firm and present.

activation_trace.role: A ladder or means makes Islam an approach that leads beyond itself rather than the terminus claimed as an achievement.
Gentle indication toward road and truth gives the movement its guide and destination.
Course, direction, and aim sharpen the directional force of guidance toward faith.
Confirmation that settles the heart supplies a qualitatively different destination from outward handover.
Completed soundness and stability make truthfulness the test of whether the approach has become a durable state.

changed_reading.before: Islam and faith are interchangeable labels for the same completed conversion.
changed_reading.after: Islam can be a real handover and means of approach while faith remains the God-guided, heart-settled destination; the conditional preserves movement and uncertainty rather than granting the speakers a completed status.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The claim places إسلامكم on the Messenger as something countable, then the verse rejects that placement and conditions صادقين.
baseline_models.mechanism: The weight-measure image of م ن ن and advance-payment image of س ل م activate a transactional reading: the speakers price their submission as prepaid value and issue an invoice to the recipient. The command rejects their measure, while enacted fulfillment leaves any genuine value unsettled until deeds realize the claim.

activation_trace.role: A named weight or measure turns boasting into the speakers' attempt to quantify and price their Islam.
Cutting or diminishing an extension supplies the feared loss against which a claimed credit would seek protection.
An advance-payment transaction casts their Islam as value paid ahead for recognition or return.
Fulfillment in action withholds settlement from speech and requires the claimed value to be realized.

changed_reading.before: The speakers merely seek praise for a religious choice.
changed_reading.after: They attempt to make Islam negotiable credit paid in advance; the verse refuses their invoice without declaring deeds valueless, and moves valuation from self-measurement to eventual fulfillment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The boast becomes one instance of advancing the self-authored valuation of an act before God and Messenger. Like a raised voice, it does more than convey information: it establishes rank over the addressee, and the surrounding possibility of action falling away makes the reminder potentially self-cancelling.

activation_trace.role: The reminder of a favor is a weight-imposing speech act whose good can be ruined by its own recital.
Advancing and taking precedence turns the boast into self-placement ahead of the authorized valuation.
Elevation of voice supplies a social mechanism by which speech raises the speaker over the addressee.
Falling and collapse make the boast capable of undoing the standing of the deed it advertises.
Intentional action is the value endangered when speech converts deed into self-elevation.

structural_cues: 49:1-2 prohibit precedence and vocal elevation before God and Messenger before 49:17 rejects a claim placed on the Messenger.
The imperative قل لا تمنوا interrupts the claim rather than merely correcting its factual content.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies precedence, raised voice, and the collapse of action; I infer that presenting Islam as a favor is a quieter form of the same rank-producing speech. A live alternative is that the earlier rules concern etiquette only and sharpen 49:17 by analogy rather than classification.

changed_reading.before: The boast is an inaccurate statement about who deserves thanks.
changed_reading.after: The boast is performative precedence: it raises the speaker, burdens the Messenger, and can make the advertised deed collapse under the very speech used to capitalize it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance toward faith is filled out as an alteration of desire and perception inside the claimants: faith is made lovable and beautiful, while disbelief and disobedience become repellent. فضل and نعمة identify this reconfiguration as divine surplus-gift, so the later divine mann is not a counter-boast but prior causal work within the recipient.

activation_trace.role: Gentle enabling toward truth is the focus action whose internal operation the context discloses.
Actual divine benefaction receives causal content beyond verbal reminder.
Love adhering to the heart makes guidance an installed attraction rather than bare information.
Displaying and producing beauty makes faith perceptually desirable within the heart.
Aversion opposed to satisfaction supplies the negative affect that clears competing paths.
Benefaction and gift identify the affective change as a surplus received from God.
Good condition and blessing name the resulting ease in which faith can settle.

structural_cues: In 49:7 Allah is the subject of the causatives حبب, زينه, and كره, all directed into or toward the addressees.
49:8 apposes the preceding transformation as فضلًا من الله ونعمة before 49:17 names Allah's mann.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine causatives, heart-location, attraction, adornment, aversion, gift, and blessing; I infer that these are the internal mechanics of هداكم للإيمان. A live alternative is that 49:7 describes a broader believing community and does not assert that every claimant in 49:17 has undergone the full change.

changed_reading.before: God's guidance means that He showed them the correct proposition or path.
changed_reading.after: God's mann includes reshaping the affective field in which choice occurs, making faith loved and luminous and its rivals repellent; their outward submission rests inside a prior gift they did not manufacture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The peace image of س ل م is destabilized by believers who can still fight. Peace is not a one-time contribution for which newcomers can invoice the community; it is maintained through return, repeated reconciliation, justice, and brotherhood. The boast therefore mistakes entry into a repair obligation for delivery of a finished social good.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation and peace activate Islam as social de-escalation while leaving its durability open.
The weighty reminder turns a contribution to peace into unilateral leverage over its recipients.
Mutual fighting shows that being counted among believers does not itself complete social peace.
Removing estrangement between people makes peace an ongoing reparative practice.
Return and turning back make repair iterative rather than a status acquired once.
Kinship converts peaceful belonging from a favor bestowed downward into reciprocal obligation.

structural_cues: 49:9 still calls both fighting parties believers and repeats the command to reconcile after return.
49:10 redescribes believers as siblings, replacing unilateral benefactor-recipient hierarchy with reciprocal relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conflict among believers, return, repeated repair, and brotherhood; I infer that the claimants treat cessation or submission as a completed peace-service owed recognition. A live alternative is that their boast concerns allegiance rather than conflict and the repair model is a social extension only.

changed_reading.before: Their Islam benefits the Messenger by adding peaceful adherents.
changed_reading.after: Even if submission contributes peace, it enrolls them in continuing reciprocal repair; it is not a finished social product that places the Messenger or community in their debt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder of conversion functions as a prestige bid: speakers raise themselves as benefactors by lowering the recipient into indebtedness. The context exposes similar rank-making speech, then recodes created group difference as mutual recognition and relocates honor to God-consciousness rather than competitive generosity.

activation_trace.role: A reminder that burdens its recipient supplies the vertical relation by which the speakers seek prestige.
Mockery and laughter expose speech as a device for manufacturing superiority over another group.
A people gathering tribes keeps group distinction relational rather than a private achievement.
Recognition through a distinguishing sign makes difference serve mutual knowing instead of leverage.
Boasting and competing in nobility names the prestige contest that the focus claim tries to win.

structural_cues: 49:11 repeats comparisons of one group being better than another, then 49:13 addresses humanity from a shared origin.
The superlative أكرمكم is transferred from social assertion to عند الله and tied to taqwa.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rank comparisons, created group difference, recognition, and competitive nobility; I infer that boasting of Islam is another speech-based bid for vertical status. A live alternative is that the claim seeks political gratitude without claiming intrinsic superiority.

changed_reading.before: The speakers ask for acknowledgment of a favor.
changed_reading.after: They use acknowledgment to manufacture rank, turning belonging into superiority; the context preserves group difference for recognition but removes self-awarded religious prestige from their control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding correction separates the utterance of faith from an acknowledged submission and locates the unresolved change as faith entering the hearts. This turns the focus ladder image into a threshold mechanism: Islam may be a genuine outer handover or first rung without yet warranting the speakers' claim to completed inward faith.

activation_trace.role: A ladder or means gives the acknowledged Islam a real but nonterminal position.
Guiding toward road and truth supplies motion beyond the threshold rather than a static label.
Heart-settling confirmation distinguishes inward faith from the claim and the admitted submission.
The pure core of a thing supplies the interior site whose transformation remains incomplete.
The same ladder image makes their commanded self-description a stage or means rather than a nullity.
Literal entry into an interior spatializes the difference between outward submission and inward faith.

structural_cues: 49:14 sequences a claim of faith, its negation, the permitted formula أسلمنا, and the not-yet entry of faith into hearts.
49:17 answers the same speakers by pairing their Islam with God's guidance toward faith.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a not-yet entry into hearts and a corrected declaration of Islam; I use the ladder branch to infer a threshold rather than a worthless counterfeit. A live alternative is that the distinction is local to these speakers and should not become a universal fixed-stage theory.

changed_reading.before: Their claimed Islam is simply false because their faith is false.
changed_reading.after: Their Islam can be an acknowledged outer handover and first rung, but they cannot convert that threshold into proof that faith has entered and settled; even the next movement remains God's guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus images of measured mann, diminution, and advance payment become an accounting dispute. Context promises that obedient works will not be diminished, then places din under God's disclosed knowledge and possible reckoning: deeds have value, but speakers cannot issue their own valuation or turn an advance into a debt collectible from the Messenger.

activation_trace.role: A measured weight supplies the self-issued quantity the speakers place on the religious account.
Cutting or diminution supplies the accounting anxiety answered by the promise that deeds are not reduced.
Advance payment turns Islam into value tendered before its full performance is known.
The wage or return of work allows obedient deeds to retain value without validating the speakers' invoice.
Accounting and recompense make their din an object of reckoning rather than a balance they control.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower assigns final knowledge of the account to God.

structural_cues: 49:14[20] uses the branchless root ل ي ت in a negated diminution construction; it supports the ledger structurally and is not branch-cited.
49:16 surrounds دينكم with repeated assertions that God knows, including every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-diminution, work and its return, accounting, and comprehensive knowledge; I infer a ledger whose valuation belongs to God rather than the claimants. A live alternative is that ل ي ت only promises no loss and دين in 49:16 means religion without activating financial reckoning.

changed_reading.before: Rejecting their boast means their submission and deeds count for nothing.
changed_reading.after: The verse rejects self-pricing, not deed-value: obedient work is not diminished, but neither an advance nor a claimed weight authorizes them to set the balance or collect gratitude from the Messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condition إن كنتم صادقين is expanded by the preceding ayah into a sequence of settled belief, absence of destabilizing doubt, strenuous expenditure of accumulated property and the self, and movement in a path. Truth therefore spends and realizes the claim; boasting instead freezes Islam as completed capital and attempts to collect on it.

activation_trace.role: Fulfillment in deed makes the focus condition demand realized action rather than verbal correspondence alone.
Measured weight supplies the stock of credit that enacted truth refuses to leave static.
Agitated doubt supplies the instability excluded before the claim can count as truth.
Exerting full capacity under hardship turns truth into costly performance.
Accumulated property supplies one material that truthful action reverses from possession into expenditure.
The very self or thing itself makes the expenditure personal rather than merely declarative.
A traversed extended road converts truth from a momentary announcement into sustained movement.
Realizing a promise in action explicitly identifies the preceding expenditure as truthfulness.

structural_cues: 49:15 uses إنما and orders faith, no doubt, striving with wealth and selves, and the conclusion هم الصادقون.
49:17 repeats the truth predicate conditionally after the speakers have treated Islam as a completed favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the restrictive action sequence and branches of doubt, exertion, property, self, path, and fulfillment; I infer that truth liquidates static religious credit into continuing expenditure. A live alternative is that 49:15 gives salient evidence of sincerity without exhausting every possible meaning of صادقين.

changed_reading.before: If you are truthful asks whether the sentence 'we submitted' matches reality.
changed_reading.after: Truth is a costly trajectory that realizes belief through property, self, and sustained movement; the boast is suspect because it accumulates credit exactly where truth disperses it into action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is enclosed by a refusal to let speakers instruct God about their din and by God's knowledge of the hidden and insight into deeds. The conditional truth test is therefore not an invitation to stronger self-certification: outward claim, inward state, and performed action occupy one field of divine visibility.

activation_trace.role: The spoken reminder is the self-report whose claimed value is placed under a knower not burdened by it.
Correspondence of speech, inner belief, and reported reality supplies the claim's multi-layer truth test.
Attestation and entrusting make din a claimed commitment that cannot certify itself merely by being reported.
Unconcealment to the knower displaces the speakers' attempt to supply God with privileged information about themselves.
What is hidden from eyes includes the inward domain that public submission cannot display.
Insight of the heart gives divine seeing depth beyond inspection of the outward declaration.
Intentional action is the visible realization against which the claimed favor is read.

structural_cues: 49:16 immediately precedes the focus with أتعلمون الله بدينكم and comprehensive knowledge; 49:18 immediately follows with knowledge of the hidden and sight of deeds.
The focus sits between repeated divine knowledge formulas, so إن كنتم صادقين remains open to a perspective beyond the speakers' report.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the immediate enclosure of claim by total knowledge, hiddenness, insight, and action; I infer that 49:17 is the middle case of self-report under that visibility. A live alternative is that teaching God in 49:16 and boasting to the Messenger in 49:17 are adjacent but distinct defects.

changed_reading.before: The claim can be repaired by giving a more accurate verbal account of conversion.
changed_reading.after: No intensified self-description can settle the claim: God sees hidden inward assent and intentional action together, so truth remains exposed beyond the speakers' power to certify it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins rare captivity, handover, and free-release branches rather than the ordinary favor sense. It remains anchored in the repeated focus roots and the explicit agency reversal, but downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory captive-ransom image, not as a lexical paraphrase of Islam or guidance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus س ل م can image both handing over and capture, while focus م ن ن can image release without compensation and ه د ي can image a captive or protection-seeker.

activation_trace.role: Free release without compensation reverses the assumption that Islam is ransom paid to the Messenger.
Handing something over gives submission the concrete motion of relinquishing control.
Capture supplies the coercive pole from which free release becomes a meaningful reversal.
A captive or protection-seeker lets guidance appear as leading someone under granted protection.

changed_reading.before: Their surrender is a valuable captive or ransom delivered to the Messenger.
changed_reading.after: They are not ransom-payers but people handed over, led under protection, and freely released by divine action; the claimed payment is itself part of what they received.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant mapped root root_001580 under QAC ه د ي and pairs severe structural collapse with sustaining strength. The focus form and mapped inventory keep it traceable, while truth's solidity makes the mechanism coherent; downstream prose must label it a form-distant anti-collapse activation, never the lexical meaning of هدى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes divine mann, هدى, and conditional truth, allowing sustaining strength, collapse, and solidity to form a structural mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Inner strength that sustains a thing, or its loss, asks what actually keeps the speakers' religious state standing.
Severe breaking or collapse supplies the failure that divine guidance is inferred to avert.
Gentle enabling toward truth provides the positive directional support opposed to collapse.
Hardness and straight solidity make truth the state that can stand under strain.

changed_reading.before: The speakers' Islam strengthens the Messenger's position.
changed_reading.after: The unresolved issue is what keeps their own faith-claim from collapsing: not their gift to the Messenger, but divine sustaining and direction toward a truth solid enough to stand.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the bodily consumption image of 49:12 reshape a boast in 49:17. It remains anchored in the focus branch where reminding can ruin a good deed and in context branches of eating, kinship tissue, and lost life; downstream prose should mark it as a material-social analogy, not equate boasting with the legal category of backbiting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus mann can burden the recipient and destroy the good of a favor, making a nominal gift behave like extraction.

activation_trace.role: The reminder that burdens its recipient and ruins benefaction anchors the reversal from giving to taking.
Literal taking of food supplies consumption as the material direction hidden inside the claimed gift.
Kinship and allegiance as joined tissue make the consumed material a social bond rather than mere flesh.
Loss of life and strength shows the social depletion produced by extractive speech.

changed_reading.before: Boasting adds a gift and merely asks that it be remembered.
changed_reading.after: The reminder can consume the bond it claims to nourish: by extracting debt and status from the recipient, a nominal benefaction reverses into social feeding on another.

strongest_changes: 49:7-8 changes guidance from external direction into God-produced love, adornment, and aversion inside the heart.
49:14 makes Islam a valid threshold before faith's inward entry, while 49:15 relocates truth from verbal credit to costly enactment.
49:16 and 49:18 enclose the boast within knowledge of the hidden and vision of deeds, denying self-certification without erasing action.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated mann sustains incompatible but coexisting mechanics: burdening reminder versus enacted gift, weighed invoice versus divine ledger, peace contribution versus repair duty, free release versus capture, and sustaining strength versus collapse. Context activates these differences without forcing one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ladder and entry describe a temporal stage, an outward-inward distinction, or only the claimants in this scene.
Whether the accounting, captivity, consumption, and anti-collapse models should remain local metaphors rather than organize continuous prose.
How far the non-dominant root_001580 activation may shape interpretation without being mistaken for the lexical sense of هدى.
